item.title: Sabarimala gold loss case: ED conducts raids in 3 states
item.description: KOCHI/NEW DELHI: The Enforcement Directorate on Tuesday conducted searches in three states as part of its money laundering investigation into the Sabarimala alleged gold loss case of Kerala, officials said. About 21 locations across Kerala, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu are being raided under the provisions of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), they said. [...]

item.title: Karnataka: DGP-Rank Officer Suspended After Alleged Office Misconduct Video
item.description: BENGALURU: The Karnataka government on Tuesday suspended a DGP-rank IPS officer, Ramachandra Rao, after a video allegedly showing him in intimate moments with multiple women inside his official office surfaced on social media. item.title: IED Found on Srinagar–Baramulla Highway, Tragedy Averted
item.description: BARAMULLA: Security forces on Tuesday averted a major tragedy after detecting an improvised explosive device (IED) on the Srinagar–Baramulla national highway, officials said. The IED was found planted along the roadside at Takiya Tapper in the Pattani area of Baramulla district. Officials said the explosive was detected during a routine patrol by security forces. item.description: NEW DELHI: Senior Congress leader Salman Khurshid said the Supreme Court missed a crucial chance to examine federalism in its “extreme form” in the Article 370 case after accepting the government’s assurance on restoration of Jammu and Kashmir’s full statehood.
